{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "plas_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized plasma glucose using training-fold mean and std for scale-normalized distance contribution.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes glucose so KNN distances are not dominated by raw scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 120.02614379084967) / 31.199327065061155"
    },
    {
      "name": "mass_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized BMI using training-fold mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Equalizes BMI contribution in Euclidean distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.172549019607843) / 7.36638927074316"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age using training-fold mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents age scale from over-weighting neighbor selection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 32.69281045751634) / 11.320223701426936"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedi_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and standardized pedigree to reduce skew before distance computation.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves geometry for a right-skewed feature in KNN distance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(pedi) - 0.3520) / 0.1750"
    },
    {
      "name": "insu_log_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed insulin standardized to a comparable scale (training-fold log mean/std approximated).",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses insulin's heavy tail so distances remain stable.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(insu) - 3.50) / 2.20"
    },
    {
      "name": "zero_sentinel_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of clinically implausible zero values among plas, pres, skin, insu, mass (likely missing-coded).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "missingness_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags poor-quality rows so KNN can separate sparse-record neighborhoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas==0,1,0) + np.where(pres==0,1,0) + np.where(skin==0,1,0) + np.where(insu==0,1,0) + np.where(mass==0,1,0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of standardized glucose and BMI capturing metabolic co-elevation as a similarity axis.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a joint dimension that clusters metabolically similar rows for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((plas - 120.02614379084967) / 31.199327065061155) * ((mass - 31.172549019607843) / 7.36638927074316)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_global_centroid",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from row to unsupervised training-fold centroid across standardized core features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a global-prototype distance signal that aids KNN density estimation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas-120.02614379084967)/31.199327065061155)**2 + ((mass-31.172549019607843)/7.36638927074316)**2 + ((age-32.69281045751634)/11.320223701426936)**2 + ((preg-3.6405228758169934)/3.1511267392158127)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_young_lean_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance to an unsupervised low-risk-style prototype (low age, low BMI, low glucose) defined from training min/typical values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates rows close to a generic baseline profile from atypical ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas-90.0)/31.199327065061155)**2 + ((mass-22.0)/7.36638927074316)**2 + ((age-22.0)/11.320223701426936)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_high_metabolic_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance to an unsupervised elevated-metabolic prototype (high glucose, high BMI, older age) using generic clinical reference values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a contrasting prototype axis improving neighborhood separation in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas-160.0)/31.199327065061155)**2 + ((mass-38.0)/7.36638927074316)**2 + ((age-50.0)/11.320223701426936)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_risk_judgment_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordinal score (0-4) reflecting general metabolic load based on combinations of elevated glucose, BMI, age, and pregnancies, using clinical heuristics not derived from outcome.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interpretable cluster indicator improving KNN neighborhood coherence.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "data_quality_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic 0-3 score assessing row data plausibility (penalizing zero-coded missing values and biologically inconsistent combinations like high BMI with zero skin thickness).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows KNN to down-weight or cluster low-quality records, improving neighbor reliability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
